description: This source file contains the implementation of the UserDAO interface, providing CRUD operations for User entities using Hibernate session factory management and password encoding.

classes.name: UserDAOImpl
classes.description: A DAO implementation class for User entity, providing methods to save, list, retrieve, delete, find by username, and change password.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a User object to the database after encoding its password.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all User objects from the database.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a User by its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a User identified by ID from the database.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Updates a User's password after encoding the new password.
